briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and DeepSeek R2 intensify AGI timeline compression as compute race accelerates

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with multimodal models showing emergent reasoning gains. Global investment remains robust while regulatory fragmentation increases. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with 2.1T parameters achieving new SOTA on GPQA. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 both launched this week, while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime defenses for multi-agent environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and CoreWeave announced joint $9B data center expansion in Texas focused on 2027 training clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve reliable 90%+ autonomous agent performance before 2027?
